providers.label: MLX Whisper (M4 Pro local)
providers.notes: Optional on-demand transcription surface. This is media inference only and is not a Brain-managed local text LLM.

providers.label: MLX Whisper (M1 MacBook remote)
providers.notes: Optional remote transcription worker. This is media inference only and is not a Brain-managed local text LLM.

providers.label: ChatGPT subscription Codex CLI
providers.notes: Secondary Brain-managed text surface under the ChatGPT subscription. Used as fallback or when Codex is explicitly preferred. No OpenAI API use and no always-on local text model.

providers.label: Claude via Amazon Bedrock
providers.notes: Primary Brain-managed text surface. Brain's shell config also runs Claude Code through Bedrock via CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1. Codex CLI remains the secondary managed text surface. No direct Anthropic API use and no always-on local text model.
